desc:
This is a Story Game!

Everyone remembers where they were when they heard the news.

In 2011, a legendary crew launched to Jupiter. They never came back. All that's left is a black box recording… and THE KEYS. 🔑🔑🔑

Now it's YOUR turn to go back.

Play as the main character of this story, CaseOh

🪐 Land on Jupiter and find out what really happened
🔑 RUN from the keys. They're fast. They're everywhere. They don't stop.
📼 Find the lost black box tapes and uncover the lore
👨‍🚀 Survive, or get left behind like the 2011 crew


Some say one crew member survived… and is still hiding somewhere on Jupiter. 👀


👍 Like the game if you'll never forget the heroes of 2011
⭐ Favourite for updates and new keys!
